description: Tier-1 centerpiece card: total portfolio value + gain/loss + return %, plus invested/last-synced footer. The only card on the screen that floats and uses h1.

totalCostBasis.description: Sum of cost_basis; drives the 'Invested' footer + return-omission guard

lastSyncedLabel.description: Relative time from max price_as_of, e.g. '2h ago'; omit footer segment if absent

estimated.description: True when some holdings lack cost basis, so return % is partial; renders an 'est.' marker

loading.description: Renders self-contained skeleton (value bar + delta + divider + caption)

colorIndependence: Gain/loss encoded by arrow (up/down) + sign (+/-) + color; never color alone.

accessibility.label: Total portfolio value {totalValue}, {up|down} {totalGain}, {up|down} {gainPercent} percent all time. Invested {totalCostBasis}. Synced {lastSyncedLabel}.
